sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.note: Difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, 1 possibly missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude, Chapter 1 meditation). Three-step roadmap: story 60-80h, 100% checklist + 70 of 80 challenges about 100h, Strangers & Freaks and clean-up about 10h. The 100% checklist is closer to 60% true completion.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

sources.name: KeenGamer
sources.note: 55 trophies, 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, 1 potentially missable (Positive Mental Attitude). Step-by-step roadmap and the full trophy table with unlock requirements.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — All 55 Trophies

sources.name: GTA-Zone
sources.note: Full 55-trophy list with Gamerscore and the platinum roadmap. Notes the five unconfirmed entries neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned down yet, and that the first meditation spot becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

sources.name: eGamers
sources.note: 55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze; 27 visible, 28 hidden; all single-player. Positive Mental Attitude is the only trophy reported as possibly missable. A Long Road (100%) is the hardest.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies And Achievements, Plus The Hardest Ones

sources.name: GTABase
sources.note: Full list of all 55 trophies with descriptions, grades, Gamerscore and hidden flags, plus a per-trophy How to unlock tip. Roadmap: about 200 hours, one playthrough, possibly Positive Mental Attitude missable, cheats disable trophies and saving. 100% checklist requirements in detail.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)

sources.name: PushSquare
sources.note: Full 55-trophy guide with per-trophy descriptions and tips. Platinum takes 300 hours or more by its estimate. 18 meditation locations, 18 collectible card sets (15 needed for 100%), 42 Shooting Range challenges, 14 Top Fun drone locations, 80 challenges (50 for the trophy, 70 for 100%).
sources.title: GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

sources.name: GTASpotter
sources.note: The list PlayStation and Xbox show since the game came out, as collected by PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements. Summarises PowerPyx's roadmap (4/10, about 200 hours, possibly one missable) and warns about the Irredeemable profile, Lucia-only and Jason-only questlines, and hourglass quests that expire.
sources.title: GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

sources.name: Official list
sources.note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this bounty opened, the two agreeing on every name, description and grade (as the competition kit states). The gate holds this guide to the same 55 names.
sources.title: PS5 trophy list as shipped in the kit
